summary_md: **Taylor Christoffersen ([@TaylorChristof2](https://x.com/TaylorChristof2/status/2116608129039302721))** describes Ai2's **LitPivot** workflow (pick papers, inspect excerpt-backed critiques, revise the proposal, refresh literature), noting a 17-researcher study showed better grounding rather than proof of more discoveries ([LitPivot](https://huggingface.co/blog/allenai/litpivot)).
